review_method: Compared every stem and every option for all 20 critical motorcycle items with the immutable Vietnamese and official key. Checked negation, exception scope, combination options, age/point qualifiers and legal vehicle categories. Read source PDF text for Q44/Q64/Q124/Q260/Q261/Q377/Q432 and visually inspected Q377/Q432 diagrams.

findings.issue: Option 2 mistranslates bánh dẫn hướng as steering wheel. In this motorcycle context it is the steered/front wheel, not a steering wheel. The teaching explanation already correctly refers to front-wheel lock.

options_en.q261_opt_2: While moving, avoid using the front brake so as not to lock the front wheel.

findings.issue: quy chuẩn kỹ thuật quốc gia means national technical regulations. National technical standards is less precise in this mandatory legal requirement.

options_en.q068_opt_1: Wear a helmet that meets the national technical regulations and fasten the strap correctly.

findings.issue: The phrase người già yếu should be rendered frail elderly people rather than elderly or frail people, which broadens the category. Preserve the source list and its maximum-two and under-12 qualifiers.

options_en.q064_opt_2: Carrying a maximum of two passengers behind when transporting a sick person for emergency treatment, escorting a person who has violated the law, or carrying children under 12, frail elderly people or persons with disabilities.

findings.issue: Official PDF page 13 confirms broad motor-vehicle/special-purpose-vehicle wording and left-hand-lane key. Do not teach this as universal practical lane advice. The existing explanation contrasts Q43 but could state the source limitation more directly.

proposed_changes.explanation_en: The original book keys the left-hand lane for this exact item. Its wording is broad: do not treat it as a universal instruction to keep left on every marked road. In actual riding, follow the applicable lane signs and current road rules. The canonical Vietnamese and official answer are retained.

findings.issue: PDF page 29 says exactly 125 cm³ in Q124 option 1, unlike Q125 which says up to 125 cm³. Current translation and note preserve this accurately; no correction required.

PDF page 60 confirms keyed option 3 says increase throttle gradually and reduce it very quickly. Current translation and explanation retain the unusual adverb pairing accurately; do not silently change to gradually reduce.

PDF page 95 confirms right-angle wording in keyed option 1. Diagram is the supplied crossbuck arrangement. Current translation explicitly retains this source wording; do not infer an independently verified general limitation to right-angle crossings.

PDF page 113 confirms the exact stem and diagram, whose second sign visibly has left/right arrows, while the supplied audited key is Neither sign. The present translation/explanation already flags this source-specific tension and does not invent a general turning rule. Keep that caution visible after commitment.

limitations: AI review, not an official English translation, human-certified translation or independent legal certification.

The reviewer authored the initial Q260/Q261 translations; those two received a self-review rather than a different-author review. The 20 critical translations and other additional source-caution items were authored by other agents.
Bundled official source is authoritative for exam scoring; review does not establish that every source statement is free of ambiguity or independently confirm later legal changes.
